visual_action: A nighttime shot of the White House with a massive, elaborate light display behind it. Beams of white and purple light shoot into the sky from a large, semi-circular structure, resembling a concert or stadium setup.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: On-screen text reads 'trump testing the lights for his 60 million dollar arena'.

on_screen_text.text: trump testing the lights for his 60 million dollar arena (ppl can't afford gas btw)

spoken_summary: A man's voice frantically and repeatedly yells for lights to be turned off, saying, "Get those lights off. Off," "They're too bright. Turn them off," and "Turn off the lights."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of a frantic male voice yelling commands, which is part of a meme audio track titled 'TURN OFF THE LIGHTS'. The tone is panicked and insistent.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot with an overlay.
manipulation_or_satire: A large, concert-style light show, described as a '$60 million dollar arena,' is digitally superimposed behind the White House to satirize Donald Trump for supposed extravagance.
cultural_references: The audio 'Turn off the lights' is a popular meme sound on TikTok.
central_claim: Donald Trump is wastefully spending millions on extravagant, self-aggrandizing projects while ordinary Americans struggle with basic costs like gas.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as a wasteful and out-of-touch leader, thereby generating anger and ridicule towards him.
